notes: No source found that is explicitly scoped to the 2017-2019 non-hybrid A2L Swift with K12C for Israel or Europe. The closest official source is the Israeli importer's own Arabic-language manual for the A2L Swift Mild Hybrid 2020-2024 (K12D, SHVS), which gives two different schedules both headed for Europe and Israel: schedule A (20,000 km/12 months grid, Class 1 = K12D) and schedule B (15,000 km/12 months grid). Israeli secondary sources (Galgalim, the IL 2016 booklet for the previous generation, local press) consistently use 15,000 km or 1 year for Suzuki, which matches schedule B. SHVS: whether the MY2019 Israeli car is SHVS is not established by any source read. The importer's manual index lists 'סוויפט Mild Hybrid' separately and its manual is dated 2020, and the 2016 booklet is for K12B, so K12C (2017-2019) coverage is a gap. Items marked 'Table-derived' in the locator come from R/I schedule-table cells mapped to column headers; their numbers are column headers, not free text. Timing: the Dualjet has a timing chain. The FR blog odopass says 'Pas de remplacement', but no official schedule found lists a timing-chain interval, so no timing_chain item was recorded. Thai-market manual (Suzuki Motor Thailand) intervals (10,000 km/6 months) are not applicable to IL but are recorded for triangulation.
